expected_direction: positive association with measured cover depth

primary_measurement_inclusion.include: all uniquely mapped test pits with one exact numeric cover depth
primary_measurement_inclusion.reason: plus and range values are censored/non-exact and will not be converted to invented exact depths

independence_filters.reason_apex: drawing note states no cover-depth verification was performed in the apex area

location_digitization.mine_grid_recovery: fit sheet PDF coordinates to labeled Tyrone mine-grid lines/intersections
location_digitization.unrecoverable_or_ambiguous_points: exclude with explicit reason before terrain extraction

terrain_source.feature_definition: same northness definition used in tyrone_six_plot_terrain_screen_v1

fixed_point_summaries.statistic: median northness of valid 10 m terrain pixels whose centers fall within the radius

primary_test.statistic: Spearman rank correlation between exact cover depth (inches) and northness
primary_test.pass_rule: rho >= 0.30 and one-sided permutation p <= 0.05 at BOTH 10 m and 20 m neighborhood radii

decision_rules.if_n_below_minimum: INSUFFICIENT_INDEPENDENT_POINTS; do not relax inclusion or independence rules
decision_rules.if_fail: close northness without rescue and move to separately preregistered thermal family
decision_rules.if_pass: northness remains a site-specific candidate requiring further independent-site validation; do not fit a transferable depth formula from Tyrone alone

forbidden: using the six plot averages as holdout observations
treating plus or range values as exact
dropping points because their northness contradicts the candidate
changing radii, rho threshold, p threshold, or direction after results are seen
